text: I understand the further into the game the harder it gets but having a hard, very hard or challenge every two levels is just ridiculous. Not only that, most of the time you have to complete 5 levels to even complete half of a single task. You only do it so that people will struggle and buy coins and power ups. You've got to make levels near impossible to force people to spend money. It's a joke. Also, STOP giving me a tutorial every time there's an event it's so annoying. I know how to play!!

How to destroy a previously excellent game, that was on a par with Candy Crush for addictiveness! They've now made it so hard to pass a level without spending money that it's almost impossible to progress. Plus they've removed the ability to be able to restart a level without losing anything if you haven't played any moves. Add to that the incredibly boring expeditions (what happened to the room renovations??), and you now have a very boring game.

Game looks great on a good phone. Some fun elements here renovating the garden. Be warned though, the game has some very difficult levels that you'll be stuck on for over a day and is essentially built around yet another pay to win model. All devs, it's really time to stop putting out games that are relentlessly after your money. It's like a thirsty parasite that is sucking on mobile gaming. Taking the fun out constantly being pushed to pay up. Only Get this if you have time and patience!

I saw the ad for the puzzle challenges, thinking that's the game. Only to find out you've got to play all this world building or random sweeping. Just be upfront and say it's a mini game within. The game itself is good for what it is. Interesting to passtime and looks good enough. I can appreciate the effort. The candy crush esque games got repetitive quickly and I got bored after unlocking the third piece of land to "clean up" I would have preferred the puzzles as main game.

Misleading ads. They show a mother and child and a 'player' making stupid decisions that make you think you could do a better job if you played the game, but it's just a scam - clickbait and download. The game is not even remotely related to using common sense NOR the ads, but it is simply just a bunch of never ending sets of puzzles (that get more difficult and time consuming) to unlock some decor and rooms and areas. Utterly scammy!

Not as advertised. At all. The actual premise is fun enough. You play levels and get stars to do tasks in a garden. My main problem is that the games you play to earn stars are just another colour swap candy crush-esque affair. All the interesting looking problem solving games in the advert are false. They don't appear at all. When the ad says "not all representative of actual gameplay" what it means is "completely different game that you'll never find on this app".

As a game, 2 stars. As a business model, 5 stars. The game starts off easy enough, getting you slowly hooked & making you believe you have a chance. Then, as the levels progress, they get disproportionately more difficult, to the point the game is practically unbeatable unless you spend £££s for in game coins to buy power ups etc. Storyline is boring too, basically just candy crush crossed with a rubbish kids book

Nothing like the adverts, it's basically like candy crush saga. It entices you in with a few easy levels, then gradually gets harder till you're going to have to start paying for addons to complete levels. If the game was a couple of pounds and there was no further ads or in game purchases I'd pay. This is rubbish though. I'll save my pennies for a decent PS4 game.

The game isn't as advertised. Not a survivor choice game. It's a Candy crush nightmare without any of the fun of candy Crush (which isn't much to begin with) the game requires Stars in order to complete actions. Stars are earned by beating Candy Crush levels. But levels can be so hard so that boosts are required. In-game money is so hard to acquire that you cannot afford to buy boosts. I got to level 76 and it is tedious too hard without spending real money which I won't do.

used to love this game but like many others. The bonus bombs from the challenge levels aren't given anymore, the number of moves in each game has reduced making it much harder, more harder levels have been added and the bonus games are becoming harder to complete due to the energy spent being higher. I think trying to get people to spend money or more money when money is already tight so I'll now be removing this game and finding another. which is a shame after getting to 7403.

For prospective players of this game, you need to understand one thing, there's very little skill involved. There's an algorithm that 'decides' when it's time for you to lose or be forced to spend upwards of 2,100 coins to continue, even if you've got the super rainbow blast and have used additional boosters. This happens on so called easy rounds too. Essentially it decides when you lose. Pretty dishonest way of designing a game, but I guess its designed to get you hooked, then spend £\$

Just another Candy Crush clone and not a very good one at that. Match 3 candies... Oh no wait, it's fruit, cause you're in a garden. Get it? YAWN! And you're digging out gnomes. DOUBLE YAWN! As pointed out by others, major false advertising showing fun puzzle games (do they ever actually happen in the game? I'm not going to play hundreds of levels of match 3 just to find out!) but the real game is something else. Very misleading, I know it's free but it's still unethical. Uninstalled.

Advert depicts a puzzle game where you save a character from a threat by moving things. This is false advertising. The game is just bejewelled. Do not download. They should either advertise the game it is or make the game they are advertising. It's pathetic honestly. If they said it was bejewelled, I might have tried it. I even play candy crush (who don't lie in their adverts).

excellent time waster - can avoid spending money, but you might feel like dropping a couple of quid here and there EDIT - a few years after my initial review and, while the Devs have continued to update the game, some of these updates have become very anti-consumer, breaking streaks, virtually forcing you to buy coins etc. I've now quit (at max level).

What has happened to this game.. I've seen so many strange ads for it recently that seem to point towards a completely different game mechanic??? My original review of 5 stars doesnt even reflect how I feel about it anymore. I'm sure the original devs weren't too happy with the direction this has gone in either. 😒 Not impressed with their business practices and decisions. Keep it to quality art and fun match 3, don't jump on silly moneymaking bandwagons!

So where do I begin? Its quite pointless, being called Gardenscapes when most of the your time is spent playing basically fruit candy crush, which if your actually interested in gardening is very disappointing. You have no option not to play for stars to be able to do anything in your garden!! Also you have no option not to save in a safe wich you then have pay real mo ey for, which is absurd. I gave it 2 stars only because I suppose if you like this kind of game at least the graphics are good!

Sneaky and deceptive, cash power ups appear in place of the replay button periodically so when you're expecting to hit replay you end up buying something you didn't want. No "are you sure?" message pops up. If you've spent real money adding coins on the game then they're effectively stealing your money by cleverly making purchases pop up where you don't expect them. Illegal surely

Awfully depressing game. Been playing for a long time now. When I first played it was enjoyable, the levels were easy with plenty of moves left over. Lots of bonuses and power ups and coins given for completing a level. But now, ALL the levels are hard and some are near impossible and take days if not weeks to complete. I can't gain power ups because I lose every level at least five times before finally passing. And getting enough coins for extra moves also takes weeks to collect. Uninstalling.

I got to level 6321. Do not install this game. The phrase "chasing cars" comes to mind. It keeps you on the same level for days if not weeks. Even when you try to pay to get through it won't always let you. Its frustrating, aggravating and an absolute scam designed to coerce money out of you. Oh, and the storage capacity you need to continue to progress through the levels and update the app is insane. Anyways, I deleted this game this morning.

Frustrating on harder levels when you know things should work out different. Super hard levels are designed to keep you there. Not great.... Why do it. I don't want to spend real money to pass a level. Some of these levels keep you stuck for days..... Really puts you off.. Game is a joke... Don't download you will get extremely frustrated. Why do you create levels that canno be passed without in app purchases. For 7 days I have been stuck on a level because there aren't enough moves to complete.

Usually I would say this game is great but I'm not sure I want to play after 2103 levels as their contact support is not very good. I didn't receive my in app purchase and trying to get the purchase or a refund is the hardest thing ever. I have contacted them three times and the first time I was promised someone would get in contact and they didn't, second and third time the messages appeared in another language.

Sorry, but negative review from me. Im level 7000+ and been playing and purchasing for years. The game has become impossible, unless you use boosters, then these stupid pink levels kill you, no matter how many you use, therefore killing your progress and momentum. All boosters you've accumulated GONE... The more you purchase, the more it wants from you! Definitely changed for the worse recently!!!

Just another generic match 3 game. Downloaded as sadly the adverts have worked on my and thought it would be have more puzzles but they are few and far between and it's not long before the game is asking you to spend money. Wish they have a version where you could just pay a flat fee but they are fishing for the whales which I understand. Not for me but if you enjoying candy crush etc and want to play a game that begs for money like that this is a good choice

I got heavily addicted to this game and it consumed my life... Yes! A little game on my phone so if you have an addictive personality I would not recommend. I eventually made myself delete it and now my mind is at ease. The thing about this game is you'll never complete it as it takes far too long! The really hard levels take forever to complete as they're trying to intise you into spending money. It's really fun at first but as time goes on it feels like a chore

I am now at level 600 and find this a great time killer. Lots of extra things to do to get bonuses and more importantly you are not forced to spend money if you don't have any. Thanks I have now gone over level 3200 and am still enjoying it. GREAT GAME I am now at 4000+ i am still enjoying it greatly .some levels are easy, some are hard. The introduction of teams was a nice touch. Thanks for a great game

In 2019 this game was a mostly fair, fun decorating game. Now 2025, it's gone severely downhill. Now you only win up to 20 coins per level max. Decorating is minimal. More expedition games with repetitive tutorials. Everything I joined to play is practically gone. Designed to get you to pay loads for minimal game. Only way to finish a side mission is to pay. As someone who won't pay, basically means the game is unpassable. Never get halfway through an expedition before it ends.

Uninstalled on the same date I installed it. With so many blocks that take 2-3 matches to remove, they give you only a few steps, making it impossible to pass nearly every time. If you're lucky, you match one and the others match themselves subsequently; if you're unlucky, you can't pass even with all the boosters. One of the most frustrating matching games I have played.

It's clear you need to pay money to level up or expect to spend a good few days if not weeks trying to pass a level. The bonus game at the moment is an absolute joke. Pay 4.99 for the pass. I didn't. I completed it and expecting to open the big treasure box at the end and get rewards only to discover you can't open it unless you pay 4.99. Keep gaining stars but you can only use those stars if you again pay 4.99 to open the box. Ridiculous and for a free game totally unfair

It's actually a pretty nice game, but I'm super annoyed by the fact that it is being advertised as a different game. It is basically glorified Candy Crush, but is showcased as a brain teaser puzzle collection on social media ads. That ad showcases 1% of the game which pops up as a "find the meaning of dream" in the main game. And it's the same with all their other games.

Don't bother if you want to play the games in the ads. I have never written a review before, but felt so cheated I just had to. I finally gave in to the ads to play the challenges - what a disappointment. They're called 'mini games', within the actual main play, which is basically Candy Crush with a progressive story. I was offered one of these mini-games in the hour I played, with no indication of when I might be offered another one. What a shame. Definition of false advertising.

Coins and power ups are way too expensive. If a level is broken, for example the butterflies still won't come up with 5 moves left and plenty of ammo to destroy them if they decided to appear, then shouldn't we be reimbursed for the cost to continue? And all of the power ups lost by failing the level. I love and hate this game. It's cute how multiple bombs and TNT's drop only at the last move encouraging you to continue but not before it costs you to do so.

Ok. The ads we are bombarded with show one game, a new type of game that looks fun. Not what you get when you download this game. It's the same as 100 other games out there (and it's not even a good version) so I will ba avoiding all games from Playrix hence forth. False advertising is a crime. We should be more strict with this. They show a better game than they provide just to get downloads.

Nothing like the ads! The advertising for this game is completely deceptive and does not show any of the actual game. It's a simple match the pieces game. So disappointed and can't believe they are allowed to continue advertising the game in the way that they do! The game functions well but I can't give higher stars due to their false advertising.

I really enjoy games like what Gardenscapes had shown in the thumnails and ads, but it ended up being one of those games like Candy Crush, constantly matching up objects to three in a row, which I find pretty meaningless. The ads are very misleading and nothing like the real game. When the game said there would be "puzzles" in the game, I thought it meant one of those where there is a problem in your way and you find the right tool to fix it, not a similarity of Candy Crush

High production values. Good graphics, with solid game play. Story fell short; I don't feel like the owner, I feel like the butler's gopher, every tiny task costs stars. Like looking up a number, calling that number, having the person called actually do something. Then, oops I ruined your work. Please pay to fix my screw up. It's fairly annoying. Also, I'm not going to say the game is a cash grab, perhaps I could play better, but it FEELS like one. Many of the levels are balanced harshly and strongly encourage paying to win with tools or extra moves. There is too much RNG and your move limit gets very restrictive as you progress. And everything is just priced too high for how frequently they come up. Enjoyed for a while, but will probably uninstall shortly.

Changed my rating from 4 to 1. This game is a joke. It is designed to be next to impossible in an attempt to make you spend money to advance. Way too many " no more moves, reshuffling ", suggested matches are consistently away from any options of advancing to the objectives, some of your only moves are for you to "waste" your bombs. The daily spin is laughable. I have NEVER gotten the jackpot. The wheel is not consistent. It speeds up or slows down to avoid landing on the jackpot section.

Why are all these games being advertised incorrectly. They all suggest an option based game where you select on of the options yo progress however when you install the games they are puzzle games in which you have to earn stars to advance. Surely this us against trade descriptions act as it is falsely advertising the product as something it isnt just to trick people into installing the app. I like the puzzle games such as this one and homescapes but the advertisement is a massive let down.

I have been playing this game on and off for quite a few years and it was a good game to play. It use to be a nice distraction while travelling to work on public transport and on my break at work etc. However what I have found is that the game has become so difficult in beating the levels it is not enjoyable to play anymore and I have removed the app from my phone.

Unfortunately the game is cheating and the levels are too hard. I pressed for 5 extra moves that cost 900 coins and the coins were taken but I didn't get the moves. In addition I bought coins and bundle of bombs but got only half of the coins surprisingly. I contacted the customer support they told me to send a screen shot of the purchase, which I did but didn't hear anything back for 2 days. It said I have to do the update of the app which I can't at the moment. No good

This game is nothing like the description it's a matching game like all the others and you earn points to fix and clean up areas. There is no chosing what happens to the characters like the adds show. I played for months and then deleted the game because I thought maybe after a while it would have a spot where you had a mini game like the add but I never found it.

Used to be fun, now it's frustrating. Pink "Challenge" levels are designed to make players lose their booster streak. Moves reduced on most levels to slow the game down unless money is spent on boosters and lives. Really disappointing, I've played since the start, but am questioning why I am still doing so. Gameplay has been modified to gain money, and the sad thing is, the addicted players will always spend it.

This game is not as advertised and I feel robbed. I've played through a few levels hoping that as the garden is set up, I'll actually get to play what was advetrisd but that doesn't seem like the reality. I will be deleting the game as I did with homescapes. They need to actually give the game they advertised. I was looking forward to a puzzle game not something Sims like kmt

very good game. keeps your interest. some levels are much harder. so save your power plays as long as possible, because you will need them for the harder levels. interaction with characters is great. so if you love match 3 games, you will love this game. The game has some levels that seem impossible to complete... Dont give up it can be done. 😊😊😊. The gardens are very unique the story line keeps you wanting to play especially when you find something unexpected.

Only 1 star due to false advertising. The game itself is great and can become addictive. However it really annoys me when I see their playable adverts, it's totally nothing like the game! You need to be truthful about the games content to get people on board & to stay loyal, lying to customers is not going to keep them playing the game, they will just uninstsll. Please stop the fake ads!!

I've been playing about a month and have reached a level where it tells me a new chapter will be coming soon. It will no longer let me collect stars or us the free power ups. I am stuck repeating the same 15 games if I want to collect points for the electric show. I am extremely disappointed. It was fun while it lasted. they do actually update weekly. it is a fun game

Sick of being STUCK on levels and then paying to get power-ups, only to have them wasted on the level and still not moving on. I understand that you have to make it challenging, but this is ridiculous!!! Not only that, when I swipe in ONE direction, the GAME moves the piece in a different direction, therefore, causing my power-ups to be wasted!!! 😡😡😡

Good, but frustrating. Also despite the fact that I have rated it, it continuously asks me to rate it every few levels. I am also not a huge fan of the Master Akira character. He seems like an asian caricature, and not a flattering one at that. If he spoke normally (or with a realistic linguistic pattern of someone who was still learning English) and not like a word scramble version of Yoda, it would come across as less xenophobic.

Absolutely love this game! However it is wayyyy to expensive when looking to buy coins or boosters. When you win a round you get like maximum 120 coins for 1 game. But to add on an extra 5 moves it costs 900 coins. Ridiculous pricing definitely. Tho I'm on like level 1300 so it hasn't put me off. Just puts me in bad form when you play this long and still cannot save any coins as they just so easily spent rather than saved. Would recommend tho,, good game to distress :)

The same as homescapes Nothing like the ads! Dont believe one minute it's ever gona be like the ads. I've played it for a few days to see it it goes from a candy crush type game to a decision game like the ads will have you believe but it doesn't, in fact it just gets frustrating and very repetitive. I mean if you like that sort of thing then by all means this is the game for you... but in my opinion it's just a click bait game.

Make no mistake, this game is all about making money . . . off you! Barely a round goes by that you can complete first time and the number of times youre left needing one piece to complete is suspicious to say the least. That said, if you have patience, all levels are winnable, but you can be stuck on some for ages. Im currently on level 433. In conclusion I'd say, good game but with one big flaw. the developers are too greedy and at times that can take the enjoyment out of it, hence 3 stars

Like others I thought this game was a puzzle game, getting characters out of silly situations, being creative with what tools you have. Instead you have to play a match game (similar to Candy Crush) to earn stars in order to do tasks around the place - I say you do tasks, more like you watch boring animations of the butler doing them. If Candy Crush with a story is for you, then enjoy, if you were hoping for something silly but puzzling then go elsewhere. Uninstalled.

Well it used to be a fun game, now it's a slog, I'm on level 7500 but now it's all but impossible to pass certain levels, then all of a sudden it gets ridiculously easy and you advance 4 or 5 levels then back to stalling. No sense of achievement, I just don't feel inclined to spend days and days on one level to have it "gifted" to you, it's free and no external ads which is a plus so 2 stars for that but the game itself is now no longer fun, I may try again in the future but for now unistalled

Gardenscapes and myself have had something of a love hate relationship for some time; I've installed and uninstalled it maybe four times so far. It's a fun game and whimsical in a sense, but like most match 3 games, it's plagued by freemium rubbish. I can't even begin to describe how juxtaposed a pound sign popping up in such a cartoonish and childlike world is, not to mention disturbing. On the plus, you can get by as F2P, though it is far from easy (which is the point, of course).

I love decorating things so this is right up my alley, but I HATE it when it comes to collecting stars. It starts off easy but once you get going the levels get really hard. And because you can't complete the levels, you can't get any stars so you're just stuck until you beat the level (unlikely) or spend all your real money getting boosters to actually have a chance at beating the level. I could say a lot more things but here you go. Don't get this game unless you want to waste all your money.

recently decided to download it again and although it started off fun, I'm at point where I get impossible "hard" or "super hard" levels that can take DAYS to do more frequently than I get fun and normal levels which kills the game. I also really hate the fact that it costs so many stars to do things that are irrelevant rather than use them to have the fun to make your garden look nice. I've seen responses to similar comments and it's clear the creator cares more about money than it's customers.

Good game, but on some animations you cannot skip (while the butler talks on the phone, or shows you tricks, bla bla. Im in for the playtime, not to watch cartoons! Would highly appreciate if there could be a setting to skip animations. Might be my patience, but I really don't wanna spend 15-20 seconds every 8-10 levels. (There's a skip option, but in some cases doesn't come up and you have to watch the story)

It is NOT a choice challenge game as they GREATLY advertise(Google must do something about these misleading adverts), Instead it's a terrible, slow and quite impossible game to complete unless you have lots of coins. Just another money hungry game. Gameplay is slow and dull, not very captivating and no wow factor. You are left staring in to the games abyss thinking 'ok what's next'. I strongly urge the game developers to STOP misleading gamers. The game is about a butler looking after a garden.

This is a very difficult rating, for one thing, if you have an obsessive or addictive personality stay extremely away. This game is rigged in lots of ways to try and frustrate you into spending money. Do not. Trust me it isn't worth it. If you think you can ignore the constant ways they ask for money, feel free to download it, but keep in mind. 1) Infinite lives are rigged, play for an hour max. 2)If you get stuck it's probably rigged, stop playing for a bit 3)levels get easier the less you play

You can get quite far to be fair to gardenscapes before they cut the move count so much it makes the levels impossible without using in app purchases to continue. But level 304 was the limit for me. Passed this to friends and family to all try and they have the same conclusion, bait and switch type gameplay to get you hooked then force you to spend ££. Just charge me a one time fee for the game and make it 'fair', at least then the Devs/publisher would have had some money out of me. I'm out!

Too expensive! Prices have gone mad. It's impossible to get anywhere without spending money. If you do spend money, it does not get you much further along in the game. Also, playing the mini treasure hunt game within the game now, only allows you to make approximately 1 move per hour, and there's a time limit to finish the game. So you're never going to complete it without spending loads. It may be ad free, and they have to make money somehow, but shame, used to be fun and relaxing: not anymore.

I'm on level 3825 I've noticed recently that when balls go together u should get a bomb or higher instead you're lucky if u get a rocker! ...im clearly a active also paying occasionally player and find this disheartening. Also the 'easy levels ' are being difficult! ..i also rely on watching ads for money but I'm lucky if I get 1 a day! .....feeling a little disheartened tbh.

Well that's a shame.... Was a great game that had lots of side games and story lines roughly around gardens. Now it's just about "expeditions". Same side games all the time and the main storyline is now, guess what, another expedition. Gone from my favourite waste of time to boring almost overnight. EDIT - Thank you for your reply, but it doesn't get around the basic problem that the whole game now revolves around expeditions, no decorations, no merge games, no gardens!

False Advertising! It is not the same game as you see in the ads. I thought if I played more I would unlock what was advertised, I paid to pass a level which I having difficulty passing only to then notice that the money was taken out of my account and I didn't receive the 5 extra moves. I'm very disappointed!!!!!! 😡

The ads of this app is such a lie totally different just please make it like the ads I thought this game was fun. And they never let you skip level with an ad only money. That's really annoying do not belive these ads, there lies, download it if you like it. The game is still amazing and please make it a bit easier my child doesn't even know what to do about the paint on the stairs. Make it easier for little kids. Thank you bye.

The ads are a little misleading. They show a kid a woman that need to be saved by solving puzzles. The puzzles are in the game but the game is more of a big standard and dull Match 3 variety. The puzzles from the game are crowbarred in and don't really fit the rest of the game. Plus there's the typical energy and power ups and limits to moves to stop you and encourage purchases etc. Bland and dull.

I used to love this game, it got me through some hard times in life and helped me to de-stress. Sadly the past few updates have shown how unfair this game really is. I understand that the game developers need to make money, but not everyone has the money to spend on these games in the way that is now being forced upon us. There are too many things to list in this review in under 500 characters, but your game has definitely declined in the fun factor over the past year. Thank you and goodbye!

Whilst the mobile version is quite unstable. It still plays quite well for what you're getting. I would recommend the Tablet, or PC versions overall. But the mobile runs quite steadily for the most part. I don't recommend you buy any of the event passes though, the game borderline flatlined when I reached a certain point.

Enjoyed playing for almost 3 years but now it's the most frustrating game I've ever played. They make you get stuck on levels for ages. I can't get past a certain level, which I have played over 50 times and no way will I be purchasing anything to boost it. They made me waste all my boosts which served no advantage to the game. You can just tell the algorithm is used to disadvantage you whenever they want you to lose and then become helpless to make a purchase. Glad I never paid a single penny.

Not enjoying this at all, only wanted the help the guy get out of trouble? With the water feature not to build him a garden,, Don't like the popping the fruit to get points to save the garden, would have preferred to go straight to the pulling pipes to save him from the fire and sharks,, not what I expected personally, bit of a drag to get to the adventure sadly deleting,,

Have been playing since the beginning. I'm on level 2824 now, finally about to finish this ridiculous level, only needed one more move to finish, didn't have enough coins so I purchased some, it glitched, purchased more, it glitched. Couldn't finish that stupid level and still don't have my coins. Contacted support and got left on read. Very disappointed

I enjoy it mostly but it does get tedious on hard levels - or even mediocre ones - when you have to do the same level for DAYS. I can't purchase, and wouldn't anyway, as my phone doesn't do that. I'm not on Facebook as I think it's a waste of space. So the game can be short and boring. Over and over again.

Get out your debit/credit card! This game started out fun and easy yes. But after a few levels it starts getting harder (obviously, yes I know) and the only way to get any further is to fork out tons of money for extra upgrades and extra chances, otherwise the game doesn't payout very well to let you succeed at the game on your own, it's litrerly akst impossible without draining your bank account. And you spend most of your time playing the stupid pizzle games like candy crush .

Albeit free, my intention was to play the cool strategy game that they let you test on the advertisements. Turns out, that's practically never and all you do is just play a really, really lame game of fruit matching. To the corporate stooge attempting to reconcile: Don't bother, we know you have to trick us with cool games in order to download the real game which is totally lame.

I'm kind of disappointed about the advertisement. The way the ad shows the game is how I want to play a game. They look more strategic and fun, especially with all the different scenarios. The actual game is nothing like it, the only thing that is similar between the two is the characters. The ads are what I want to play and I have gotten stuck on the same level for a while. If at all possible, could the developers make the advertisement into a real game?

MISLEADING ADS: you'd think it's a logic pin game, but it's actually a match3 game with just a few pin games. First you can customize a lot of things in your garden, but soon you have to spend 2 stars on just examining some elements or calling others on the phone. You only have 5 attempts, so beating even a normal difficulty level can take hours, since most of the time you need to be lucky to win. Making progress takes too long, and it's not fun anymore. I gave 2 stars bc the game looks pretty

Seems like a game that could be great but has a poor system for making coins and gathering stars in order to progress. I've played many similar games and this one appears to like to be complicated and the levels in the mini game are not easy enough to retain players. Of all 30 friends who have played sometime in the last, all are low level and clearly quit early on. I've been playing for days and still havent gotten to play the minigame where you fix all sorts of house and garden problems. :(

I keep getting these ads to play these puzzle games that look very challenging and they are not what was pictured in the advertisement. I downloaded them and started to play the game and it turned out to be a different version of candy fruit saga. Then the advertisement ads were filling up my tablet. I am so disappointed that all of the talented minds that produce these games are trying to be the next person in line to the {get rich quick thinking} please put out a good product we want to pay for

Definitely not what the ad shows you at all. I have been playing it for weeks and not Once did I play a game that looked like anything on the ads.
